title: Observing Individual Differences in the Prophetic Tarbiyah

text_simplified: The text shows that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ would observe individual differences among the Companions in tarbiyah (upbringing), never burdening anyone beyond their capacity. The hadith teaches us the importance of understanding each child’s abilities and not forcing them into what they cannot bear, while considering their psychological and social differences.

review_defects.arabic: فلم يكن يكلف أحدًا فوق طاقته
review_defects.english: never burdening anyone beyond their capacity
review_defects.why: The English adds 'never', which is not explicitly present in the Arabic. The Arabic uses a past negative habitual form (لم يكن يكلف) meaning 'he did not burden', not an absolute 'never'.
